articles.title: How a five-second trick let traders drain millions from Polymarket
articles.snippet: After months of public warnings from onchain analysts, the prediction market is moving to time-weighted prices to make artificial price pushes too costly.

articles.title: Senate won't vote on crypto Clarity Act before its summer break
articles.snippet: The U.S. Senate won't go on its August recess just yet but it will not vote on the Clarity Act this month, dimming hopes that the bill can become law this year.

articles.title: Bitcoin price tags $65.3K August high as low US jobs numbers cool Fed rate bets
articles.snippet: Bitcoin hit month-to-date highs above $65,000 as risk-assets gained on low US nonfarm payrolls data.

articles.title: CEX perpetual futures volume falls to $4T, lowest since late 2023
articles.snippet: Perpetual futures trading volume on crypto exchanges fell to its lowest level in 31 months, while perpetual trading on decentralized platforms neared a one-year low.

articles.title: Coldcard exploit pushes July losses to $247M as second-worst month of 2026
articles.snippet: The Coldcard exploit, which caused more than $100 million in losses, helped push July crypto thefts to $247 million, making it the second-worst month of 2026.
